title: Dynamite Stick
body:
"Can be used to output a small explosion, with a small range. Any dynamite sticks which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and can be used to chop trees or break ores."

Description

The Dynamite Stick has a weak explosion, and a small radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores, and can be used to open the gate at the Skull Rock to get the Skull.

Unlike bombs, dynamite blows up almost instantly in a chain reaction.

Trivia

● This price was originally priced at $2,150
